why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P1 shell-1.7): the route error screen `createBasaltRouter` installs offers one action, Try again, and it does not retry. `ErrorComponent` calls the error boundary's `reset` only (`src/provider/route-defaults.tsx:25`), so the failed loader is not re-run and the same screen comes back; the services in the cycle build stayed unreachable until a reload, though the next call would have succeeded (`.evidence/cycle-shell-1/actions.log` A12).
what: Try again re-runs the failed route's loader.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/provider/create-router.tsx (only if the screen needs the router)
change: Try again invalidates the router (`useRouter().invalidate()`) and then resets the boundary, the TanStack pattern for a loader error, while staying provider-free. A router test mounts a route whose loader throws once and then resolves, clicks Try again once and finds the route's content.
acceptance: A loader that fails once and then succeeds renders its route after one click on Try again (router test)
out_of_scope: The not-found screen and the pending state (v3-shell-1-shell).
